chapters.title: Return to Balamb Garden
chapters.content:
{{CALLOUT:card|Before entering Garden}} At the front gate, you can still leave and reach **Balamb Town**; the rest of the world is not a useful detour yet. If the **Queen of Cards** is currently in Balamb, this is a rare chance to adjust the town's rules before the Garden crisis locks down travel. If you want the **All** trade rule for card collecting, set it now and verify Balamb's rules with a local player. Avoid starting an unwanted Queen card-loss step or spreading a rule you do not want.

Junction the active party, then approach Garden. When a Faculty member stops you, answer **I don't get it** and defeat the forced **Grat + Caterchipillar** fight. At the gate, speak to the seated child twice for a **Mega-Potion**, then enter. Walk into the main hall and approach **Fujin and Raijin** for the crisis scene; the usual Save Point is gone.

{{CALLOUT:hint|High-level enemy check}} If early beach training left Squall at a high level, the fixed Garden fights can use stronger spell tables. High-level **Bombs** may carry **Firaga** and **Meltdown**; Meltdown is valuable for Vitality junctioning and lowers a target's Vitality to zero when cast. Check the encounter panel for the level context before spending turns on Draw.

{{CALLOUT:point|Garden Crisis room route and rewards}} The elevator and directory are disabled. Sweep the first floor **clockwise**, starting at the Infirmary, and clear each room's scripted fight. Help the Garden Faculty or say you support Cid whenever asked. Speak to each listed person after the battle to collect the reward; in the Dormitory, use the bed and Save Point before moving on.
| Area | Possible fight | Speak to | Reward |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Infirmary | Caterchipillar or Granaldo | Dr. Kadowaki | Elixir |
| Quad | Bomb, Glacial Eye, or no fight | Back-most male SeeD | X-Potion |
| Cafeteria | Bomb | Second girl from the left; speak twice | Gysahl Greens |
| Dormitory | Caterchipillar | No reward NPC | Bed and Save Point access |
| Parking Lot | Grendel | Upper SeeD | Tent |
| Training Center | T-Rexaur | SeeD | Remedy |
| Library | Grat | Girl with pigtails | Remedy, or Mega-Phoenix with Zell |

{{ENCOUNTERS:0}}

{{CALLOUT:relationship|Zell Love Scene #4}} Before the Library fight, put **Zell in the active party**. After defeating Grat, speak to the Library Girl with pigtails. Zell's presence advances his sidequest and changes the reward from **Remedy** to **Mega-Phoenix**.

After all seven rooms are cleared, return to the main hall. Ride the elevator, go to the far end of the hallway for a scene, ride the elevator again, and keep speaking to Cid until he gives the party the MD Level assignment. Take the elevator down to begin the maintenance route.

{{ENCOUNTERS:1}}

{{CALLOUT:point|MD Level route}} When the elevator stops, examine its control panel, then the floor hatch and climb down. Open the next hatch and descend into the passage. Junction **Fire** to Elemental Attack; most enemies here are weak to it, though Buel and sometimes Blobra are exceptions. Follow the ladder and catwalk route to the pressure valve. Use the action button repeatedly; Squall cannot turn it alone, and the other party members help after he struggles.

In the open area with the large central column, draw from the **Full-Life Draw Point** on the right side. Continue to the ladder going upward and choose either of the top two dialogue choices. After the scene, examine the nearby control panel, climb back down, then inspect the flashing light near the bottom of the screen to open the gate. Descend to the lower level and save before the next fight. Drawing here continues **Magic Miner** progress if you still need it.

At the bottom, flip the switch and finish junctioning before approaching the doorway. Keep Fire on Elemental Attack; **Sleep** on Status Attack and **Blind** on Status Defense can help. Enable **Mug** if you want the Oilboyles' items. Running toward the nearby door triggers the fixed Oilboyle pair.

The two **Oilboyles** are a scripted fight; use their capped MD Level encounter entry rather than the generic Oilboyle data. Protect against **Oil Blast**, which removes 62.5% of current HP, and heal after it. Sleep or Slow can create safe turns. Defeat both, then descend the ladder and follow the catwalk to examine the console and trigger the next scenes.

After the Garden moves, talk to Cid twice, agree to check on the others, take the lift and elevator, and go to the end of the second-floor hallway for the balcony scene. Return inside for the follow-up scenes. When the situation settles and Squall regroups, use the optional windows below before continuing to the B1 Master Room.

{{CALLOUT:card|First CC Group window}} With Garden mobile, start the **CC Group** chain. Jack walks through the Main Hall; check with him after **15 wins** in qualifying Garden locations. Wins in the Library, Cafeteria, and Classroom do not count. If he will not play, keep winning in eligible locations and ask again. After beating Jack, Joker appears randomly on the right-hand path in the Training Center; his first win upgrades the Battle Meter to **GF Report**, and he may play the **Leviathan Card**. Club wanders the 1F corridor near the Cafeteria, Dormitory, and Parking Lot; the Diamond duo stops near the Main Hall directory. CC members can use Level 7 boss cards, and the Diamond duo is a useful source. Win any rare cards you want to keep while the members are available. To finish Steam's **Cards Club Master** achievement, defeat every member before the end of Disc 3; the group then appears aboard the Disc 4 Ragnarok for rare-card recovery.

{{CALLOUT:card|Spade before leaving for FH}} Before taking the 2F balcony route to Fisherman's Horizon, challenge **Spade in Garden's 2F Hall** if you have not already. You can catch him during this departure window.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Novice SeeD Candidates window 3}} Before leaving for Fisherman's Horizon, return to the Cafeteria and speak to all three novice candidates until their dialogue repeats. This is their third story window after the MD Level; the next chance is after visiting FH. There is no immediate item, but all five windows are required for the later payoff scene.

After the Garden scenes, Squall wakes in the Dormitory. If Rinoa is in the party, he gives her a short tour. Head to the front gate for the announcement, then prepare before going to B1: junction **Aero** or another Wind spell to Elemental Attack if available, protect against **Silence** and **Slow**, and assign **Draw** and **Mug** to the active party. Save in the Dormitory if you have not saved since the MD Level.

Go to the **Master Room** on B1 and speak to Cid. Follow the route around the room and down the short stairway; the next scene turns into a boss encounter. NORG's pod is harmless. Keep **Draw** and **Mug** equipped before breaking it; the two Orbs can interrupt the fight but cannot be permanently defeated.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Draw Leviathan from NORG}} When the pod opens, **Draw Leviathan** from NORG before defeating him. This is the story's first GF opportunity and the draw is missable; the backup is a much later Draw from Trauma in Ultimecia Castle. Drawing Leviathan also awards the official Steam **Leviathan** achievement.

{{ENCOUNTERS:2}}

During the fight, watch the Orbs' color cycle: blue, yellow, then red. Red Left Orb uses dangerous attack magic, while red Right Orb uses status magic; a hit lowers its color by one step. Once you have handled the Orbs' Draw and Mug opportunities, destroy the pod to expose NORG. Draw **Leviathan** if you have not already, then Mug **Circlet** if you want it. NORG is weak to Wind and vulnerable to Slow; Meltdown followed by strong attacks works well. Drawing Leviathan prevents NORG from using Water. The panel provides the level-specific Draw lists for NORG and the Orbs.

After the NORG battle, use the post-crisis free period to take **SeeD written tests** from Tutorial → Information; passing tests can still raise your SeeD rank. Then organize the new GF's abilities while there is time to junction.

{{CALLOUT:refinement|Leviathan GF ability priority}} If you have **4 or more Blobra Cards**, Card Mod them into a **Rune Armlet** and use it to teach **Spr+20%** to Leviathan. If you kept a **Force Armlet** from X-ATM092 and are not saving it for Rinoa's weapon route, it can teach **Spr+40%** and skip straight toward **Spr Bonus**. Set Leviathan to learn **Supt Mag-RF**, then the Spr+% abilities, **Spr Bonus**, **GFRecov Med-RF**, **Boost**, junctions, and remaining abilities.

{{CALLOUT:mechanics|GF grouping after Leviathan}} With all GFs available so far, a clean grouping is: **Strength** - Squall plus Zell/Irvine with Quezacotl and Ifrit; **Defense** - Quistis plus Irvine/Zell with Brothers, Carbuncle, and Leviathan; **Magic** - Selphie plus Rinoa with Shiva, Siren, and Diablos. If Carbuncle has not learned **Mag-J**, temporarily move Diablos to the Defense group when a strong Draw user is needed, then prioritize Mag-J on Carbuncle or Leviathan after refinements and stat bonuses.

Before leaving the NORG area, equip **Move-Find** and reveal the hidden **Bio Draw Point** beside NORG's remains. Then go to the Infirmary, tell Dr. Kadowaki you need to see Cid, and work through the dialogue options. Continue to the entrance area, the second-floor balcony, and the Library.

{{CALLOUT:relationship|Zell Love Scene #5}} In the Library study area, Squall is alone and the scene plays regardless of party. It still counts toward Zell's love-quest finale.

After the Library scenes, Squall returns to the Dormitory. Leave and head south for the next story scene, then take Balamb Garden toward **Fisherman's Horizon**.

chapters.title: Fisherman's Horizon
chapters.content:
{{CALLOUT:story|Fisherman's Horizon arrival}} After the Garden crisis, leave Balamb Garden from the **2F balcony** and follow the metal walkway into Fisherman's Horizon. After the arrival scene, keep talking to the first local until he walks away. Continue to the large water tank. If you previously spoke to the Cafeteria Lady, speak to her son here for the optional extra dialogue; he has another station-area conversation after the BGH fight.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Master Fisherman's Quest — Part 1}} At the left side of the large tank, find the partly hidden ladder, climb down, and follow the path left and up to the fisherman at the end of the crane. Speak to him to receive the unique **Occult Fan III**, then speak to him again. Return up and take the elevator down to the docks. On the southernmost dock, talk to his pupil and answer **Sort of**, **I saw him**, and **I was...kind of...impressed**. Keep talking until the pupil stops casting. Complete this first part before entering the upstairs room in Mayor Dobe's house; Part 2 must wait until after the bridge and Mayor scenes, while Squall is alone, and must be finished before returning to Garden.

{{CALLOUT:point|Lower-town route}} From the docks, follow the tracks toward town. Near the Save Point, draw **Regen** from the reusable point; the Queen of Cards may also be there if her current route places her in FH. The building along the main drag combines the Item Shop and Inn. Pick up **Timber Maniacs #7** from the room upstairs. Continue one screen right past the man on the boat: the **Shell Draw Point** is by the docks, beside the old man who runs the **Junk Shop**. Return to the main drag, go up the ramp, and enter the house on the right for **Timber Maniacs #8**. Examine the **Moomba doll** inside for its scene, then speak to Grease Monkey if you want his dialogue before the later reward. Both FH magazines count toward the Steam **Timber Maniacs** achievement, and drawing from each newly available point advances **Magic Miner**.

{{CALLOUT:card|FH card route}} Handle card opportunities in the route order below, saving before optional matches and declining unwanted rule mixing:
- At the Save Point, play the **Queen of Cards** only if her location and your intended Queen step make this the right time. Do not deliberately lose a card here. Keep your desired trade rules; Queen progress can wait if she is not on the planned route.
- On the screen to the right of Mayor Dobe's house, **Martine** can return the **Ifrit Card** if it was lost to Caraway, as well as rare cards lost to Galbadia Garden players. Challenge him only for a card you need or for an intentional rule change; save first if you choose to mix rules.
- After going upstairs in Mayor Dobe's house, challenge **Mayor Dobe** for the **Quezacotl Card** before advancing the scene. If you previously gave **Sacred** to the Queen of Cards, challenge **Flo** for the conditional **Irvine Card**. Sacred can later be recovered from the Queen's son in the **Dollet artist's house**; handle that on a later Dollet visit rather than detouring now. If Sacred was not lost to the Queen, Irvine is available from other later card players.

{{CALLOUT:point|One-time Ultima Draw Point}} On the right side of the upstairs room in Mayor Dobe's house, use **Move-Find** to reveal the invisible **Ultima Draw Point**. This is the earliest Ultima draw and it does **not** recharge, so draw now with your highest-Magic character and any Mag+ abilities equipped. It counts for **Magic Miner**. The nearby Regen point is reusable; do not treat this Ultima point as a repeatable source.

When ready, leave the house and continue toward Garden until the soldiers' arrival scene sends you back to Mayor Dobe. Speak to the people in the house, then follow the route up to the station. Use the Save Point on the tracks and prepare the party before approaching the abandoned station.

{{CALLOUT:preparation|Station encounter}} Random encounters can occur along the tracks. Before the station scene, set Lightning, Water, or Earth on Elemental Attack if useful and equip **Mug** if it was removed. At the station, either response advances the scene. Defeat the **Elite Soldier and two G-Soldiers**, then BGH251F2 arrives.

{{ENCOUNTERS:0}}

Keep **Draw** available if you want **Stop** from BGH251F2 and Mug **Adamantine** for its GF ability. This is the Fisherman's Horizon rematch, separate from the earlier Missile Base fight. Lightning- or Earth-elemental attacks can help, **Shell** halves Beam Cannon damage, and Blindness or Slow can limit the threat.

After the fight, speak to **Rinoa**, then **Mayor Dobe**. Choose **I want him to understand us**, then **Try to continue**. Leave and return to the station square; if you spoke to the Cafeteria Lady earlier, talk to her son three times here. The **Haste Draw Point** is inside the station. Draw from it now if wanted; this is another point toward **Magic Miner**.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Master Fisherman's Quest — Part 2}} While Squall is alone and before leaving FH, return to the pupil and talk to him after he finally catches a fish. Go back up to the Master Fisherman's crane spot; Irvine joins along the way if he has not already. Speak to the fisherman, then meet him upstairs in the Inn. Answer **Why not...?**, follow him to the dock, talk to the shopkeeper, and finish the last fisherman conversation. This earns a **Megalixir** and **20 SeeD Exp**. If you already completed Grease Monkey's task with Squall and Irvine, answer **Yes** when asked about help returning; otherwise answer **No** to avoid an unnecessary trip. If you completed both Shumi Village quest phases on Disc 2, return to the workshop for the scene that opens a **Full-Life Draw Point** at the Master Fisherman's former seat; check it after this quest. Completing both phases for the first time on Disc 3 does not trigger the scene or point. Then, with **Squall and Irvine in the active party**, return to Grease Monkey's house near the station. Speak to the officer, leave and re-enter, then speak to Grease Monkey for the **Mega Phoenix**. Return to Balamb Garden afterward.

checkpoints.label: Master Fisherman's Quest
checkpoints.description: Meet the Master Fisherman before entering Mayor Dobe's upstairs room, collect Occult Fan III immediately, finish the pupil dialogue, then complete Part 2 before returning to Balamb Garden.

checkpoints.label: Quezacotl Card

enemies.name: BGH251F2 (FH)

chapters.title: The Garden Festival
chapters.content:
{{CALLOUT:story|Garden Festival opening}} After the Fisherman's Horizon events, return to Balamb Garden. Irvine tells Squall that Selphie needs cheering up. Go to the **1F Quad**, talk to Selphie, and choose **Cheer her up** to trigger the setup scenes.

{{CALLOUT:mechanics|Concert instrument combinations}} Choosing a song has no item reward, but you will hear the music again later. Character assignments do not affect the song; the four instruments must match one complete set.
| Song | Instruments |
| --- | --- |
| Irish Jig | Guitar, Violin, Flute, Tap |
| Slow Dance | Sax, Electric Guitar, Piano, Bass Guitar |

{{CALLOUT:missable|Irvine's temporary solo window}} While choosing the band, wait until you have selected Zell's instrument and control Irvine, then leave the rehearsal area **before confirming Zell's choice**. Return to the Grease Monkey house near the abandoned station, which you visited during the FH stop. The returning Galbadian Officer now has another event: speak to him, leave and re-enter the house, then talk to Grease Monkey for a **Phoenix Down**. Examine the injured officer for **15x Fast Ammo**, **10x AP Ammo**, and **5x Pulse Ammo**. Return to the rehearsal. While Irvine is still under your control, visit the Garden **Library** and speak directly to the **Library Girl with Pigtails** for Zell Love Scene #6; talking to the other Library Committee members does not count. This is a short window, so complete both errands before finishing the band setup.

Return to the Quad and speak to each band member to confirm their assigned instrument. Use one of the complete combinations above. Once the setup ends, control returns to Squall in the Dormitory. Leave the Dormitory and approach Rinoa for the scene; any reply is safe and changes only the dialogue. Talk to Irvine **twice**, then go toward Mayor Dobe's house. From the stage, go right and **examine the magazine** to continue.

checkpoints.label: Festival ammo and Phoenix Down
checkpoints.description: As Irvine during band rehearsal, after selecting Zell's instrument but before confirming it, revisit Grease Monkey's house for Phoenix Down and inspect the beaten-up Officer for 15x Fast Ammo, 10x AP Ammo, and 5x Pulse Ammo.

checkpoints.label: Zell Love Scene #6
checkpoints.description: During Irvine solo control, speak directly to the Library Girl with Pigtails.

chapters.title: Exploring the World
chapters.content:
{{CALLOUT:story|Garden at sea}} When Squall wakes up, head to the **3F bridge** for the next scenes. Once control returns, Balamb Garden can travel to most of the world, though much of the eastern landmass remains out of reach. **Xu suggests visiting Balamb**; the optional work below is a useful cleanup window before following that lead.

{{CALLOUT:hint|UFO note}} A strange UFO encounter can begin appearing on the world map from now on. It belongs to a quest that cannot be completed yet. If you meet it by chance, make a note and move on; save active UFO hunting for the later steps when the full route is available.

{{CALLOUT:sidequest|Garden stops first}} Before leaving Garden, visit the **Cafeteria** and speak to all three Novice SeeD candidates until their dialogue repeats; this is their fourth window. Then finish any remaining **CC Group** matches. Resume with Jack or the next undefeated member, then continue in order through Club, Diamond, Spade, and Heart (Xu on the bridge); after speaking to Dr. Kadowaki, rest in Squall's dorm until King appears. Joker can be challenged after Jack and is a separate optional match. Defeating the full group completes the **Cards Club Master** achievement route and preserves the Disc 4 rare-card recovery service.

{{CALLOUT:gf|Centra Ruins: Tonberry first}} For Tonberry, approach the southern Centra ruins from the **western side**; the bridges make a direct Garden approach from the Balamb side impractical. Save before entering. The ruins impose a 20-minute timer while Odin is undefeated, so leave Odin's statue route for later if you want to avoid random **Zantetsuken** interruptions in future battles. Fight uncarded Tonberries in the lower ruins until Tonberry King appears. Carded Tonberries do not count, and **Enc-None** prevents the needed fights. Ordinary attacks trigger Everybody's Grudge, whose damage grows with the number already defeated; use Demi, magic, or Limit Breaks instead, and keep Protect or Mighty Guard ready for the King. Leaving and re-entering resets the timer without clearing Tonberry progress. Defeating the King recruits **Tonberry GF** and unlocks the Steam **Tonberry** achievement. Odin is a separate timed statue-and-code route if you choose to recruit him now.

{{CALLOUT:training|Cactuar AP stop}} The early Cactuar training area is on the mainland beside the small island in the southeastern **Kashkabald Desert** region of Centra; the map can label it “Cactuar Island,” but this early route is reached from the desert shore. Cactuars award **20 AP and little EXP**, making them useful for ability learning. They evade most attacks, so use **Triple on Hit-J** for characters without Squall's reliable weapon accuracy.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Shumi Village Timber Maniacs timing}} Visit Shumi Village and do its optional work now, but leave **Timber Maniacs #9** in the Artisan's House until after the Laguna battle in Trabia Canyon on Disc 3. Taking the magazine early keeps Ward out of that battle; the issue is still available afterward. The village quest and paid Ultima draw can both be completed now.

{{CALLOUT:point|Shumi Village and Ultima}} Shumi Village is beneath the dome on the northernmost island of Trabia. Save outside before paying **5,000 Gil per draw** at the Ultima Draw Point; reload if the draw count is poor. The point can be used again after it refills through travel and quest progress, so draw on later visits as well; every draw also counts toward Steam's **Magic Miner** achievement. Follow the Shumi Village route in Sidequests for the sculptor's stones and Elder rewards (**Phoenix Pinion** and **50 SeeD Exp**). Its second phase can also be finished during this open-world period: complete the village conversations, collect the Moomba Doll from the Grease Monkey in Fishermans Horizon, then return to the Artisan and Elder for **Status Guard**. The magazine timing warning above still applies.

{{CALLOUT:card|Chocobo Forests and Chicobo}} The Beginner's Forest near Shumi Village is a convenient first stop; ChocoBoy charges **1,000 Gil** for entry. Use **ChocoWhis** from the menu, hold **Circle** for ChocoSonar to find Chicobos, then use ChocoZiner to call them down. Once exactly one Chicobo remains, press **X** to call its mother; locate the forest treasure with the sonar and use ChocoZiner there. Riding the mother Chocobo is enough for Steam's **Chocobo** achievement. For the Queen of Cards route, solve all six forests, ride from the Roaming Forest through the shallow-water path to Chocobo Sanctuary, and collect the **Chicobo Card**. Only then lose Chicobo to the Queen as directed in the Queen route, and win **Chubby Chocobo** from the student outside Balamb Garden Library; recover Chicobo later if desired. The Sidequests route lists the six forest locations and treasure rewards.

{{CALLOUT:sidequest|Winhill return: vase fragments}} Winhill lies on the southeast side of the Galbadia continent, and its local Item Shop is open during this visit. Finish the optional vase quest before time compression seals the towns. Approach from the north and bring Quistis or Irvine. The four pieces can be collected in any order; this route starts at the mansion. Ask the owner on the stairs about his missing vase, inspect the suit of armor, then step away and collect the fragment it reveals. In Raine's former home/pub, speak to the woman upstairs until she mentions flowers; downstairs, inspect the flower bowl, approach the apparition, then examine the cat for another piece. At the flower shop, inspect the flowers at the bottom twice. On the southern road where the Chocobo warning appears, kick the running Chicobo once for the final fragment. Return all four pieces to the mansion owner for a **Holy Stone**. Kicking the Chicobo twice more yields **Gysahl Greens** and a **Phoenix Pinion** (the message calls it a Phoenix Down).

{{CALLOUT:card|Winhill Triple Triad}} This is the first time you can challenge Winhill residents; the Laguna dream was not a card-playing window. The eight local players use **Centra rules** and none carries a unique rare card, so there is no must-win opponent here. Their ordinary-card ranges and locations are: Student Mercenary (Lv 1-3 and 5) by the southern exit; Shop Owner (Lv 1, 2, 4) in the item shop; Hotel Owner (Lv 1, 2, 4) in the hotel; Old Man (Lv 1, 4, 5) in the southern residence; Man on the bench (Lv 1, 3, 5) and Playing Girl (Lv 1-4) in the north square; Mansion Owner (Lv 3-5) on the mansion stairs; Blonde Woman (Lv 1, 3, 4) in Raine's former home. No individual player disappears during the open-world window, but Winhill becomes inaccessible when time compression seals the towns. Skip them if you only want unique cards, and refuse unwanted rule mixing if keeping Centra rules from spreading is important. The Queen of Cards can also be at the Winhill hotel depending on her current route; challenge her only if it matches the Queen step you are pursuing, and avoid accepting an unwanted rule mix.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Pet Nametag #2 pickup}} If the Timber journalist was encouraged on Disc 1, return to the square outside the Timber Maniacs building and speak to him for the **Pet Nametag**. This open-world visit is a convenient fallback if the earlier post-Missile Base pickup was missed. While in Timber, the train-station scene with the girl on the tracks can also be viewed; the hotel ticker changes afterward, but she gives no item.

{{CALLOUT:route|Earlier town cleanup}} Dollet and Deling City remain reachable for any earlier optional cards, magazines, shops, or town quests you left unfinished. Use their earlier walkthrough entries for the exact routes. If you have not done the **Dollet Bone Quest**, you can complete it now for its current reward tier or defer it to the later Disc 3 visit for upgraded items.

{{CALLOUT:refinement|Open-world Card Refinements}} This is the first open window with **Supt Mag-RF**, access to **Level 7 Cards** through Martine or the CC Group, and several new rare-card/refinement routes. Use the top Cards and Refine tabs for exhaustive recipes, but the high-priority new options are:
- **Rinoa Card** -> 3x **Magic Armlet**
- **Carbuncle Card** -> 3x **Glow Curtain** -> 300x Reflect via Supt Mag-RF
- **Irvine Card** -> 3x **Rocket Engine** -> 150x Triple via Time Mag-RF
- **Gilgamesh Card** -> 10x **Holy War**
- **Tiamat Card** -> 10x Flare Stone -> 10x Flare
- **Red Giant Card** -> 5x Meteor Stone
- **Ultima Weapon Card** -> Ultima Stone
- **Ifrit Card** -> 3x Elem Atk
- **Quezacotl Card** -> 100x Dynamo Stone -> 2,000x Thundaga
- **Imp Card** -> Wizard Stone -> 20x Dispel
- 4x **Blobra Card** -> Rune Armlet -> 40x Shell
- 2x **X-ATM092 Card** -> Turtle Shell -> 30x Protect

When this optional cleanup is done, continue the main story by taking Garden to **Balamb**.

chapters.title: Return to Balamb
chapters.content:
{{CALLOUT:story|Balamb occupation}} Take mobile Garden to **Balamb**. Go toward the car rental place for the occupation scene, speak to the hotel owner and his wife, then talk to the entrance guard. Walk away and re-approach the guard for the follow-up. **Zell must be in the party**; if he is not, the game adds him. **Selphie is optional.** Continue into town and enter Zell's house, then the room on the right. The town's usual Item and Junk Shops remain open during the occupation if you need supplies or weapon remodeling.

{{CALLOUT:sidequest|Optional sneak-out and early Pandemona Card}} Before continuing the Captain search, you can unlock a temporary exit and an early Pandemona Card. First visit the house next to Zell's and talk to both the girl and the man there. In Zell's house, speak to the **Big Bad Rascal** twice and to **Ma Dincht** at least once, then talk to the Hotel guards. Return to the neighboring house and speak to the Rascal. Follow him to the town entrance and talk to the guard; leave the dialogue box open until the Rascal finishes speaking with the Hotel owner and his wife. Go back to Zell's house and talk to the Rascal, then speak to him once more to leave town. While outside Balamb, Selphie is removed from the party. The **Hotel owner's daughter**, in the house next to Zell's, can now play the **Pandemona Card**. The Hotel owner is a fallback player after the occupation is resolved.

{{CALLOUT:mechanics|Captain search and Zell's room}} If you have not already spoken to the Hotel guards, do so now; they direct you to find the Captain. The party cannot stay at the Hotel, so rest and save in **Zell's room**. If Selphie is present, do **not** side against her in the bedroom scene or SeeD Rank is reduced. Then go to the harbor and talk to the guard with the dog. Return to Zell's house; when smoke appears at the door, go inside and talk to Ma Dincht about the Captain.

{{CALLOUT:mechanics|Captain search rewards}} The **dog route** is the best option: return to the harbor, talk to the dog again, and follow it to the train station and the Captain for **+100 SeeD Exp**. The other options are to board the train after repeatedly speaking to the soldier blocking it (**+65 SeeD Exp**) or wait around until the Captain appears at the Hotel (**no SeeD Exp bonus**). Heal before completing the first boss battle because the Hotel rematch begins immediately afterward.

{{CALLOUT:preparation|Hotel battle preparation}} Before meeting the Captain, junction **Bio to Elem-Atk**, **Darkness to ST-Atk**, equip **Mug**, and make sure a character has **Draw**. Bio strengthens physical attacks against both bosses, while Darkness helps against their physical pressure. Poison, Sleep, and Slow are also useful if available.

{{ENCOUNTERS:0}}

**First Hotel battle — Raijin and two G-Soldiers:** Remove the soldiers first, then focus on Raijin. Keep Lightning off Elemental Attack; Poison, Darkness, Sleep, Slow, or Drain can limit his turns. Draw from Raijin only for spells you still need. If only female characters are standing, he will not use his normal attacks against them.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Pandemona — draw from Fujin}} The rematch against **Raijin and Fujin** starts immediately after the scene, so heal and junction before the first fight ends. Draw **Pandemona from Fujin before defeating her** to recruit the GF and unlock its achievement. Fujin can use Sai to leave a character at **1 HP** when her HP is low; heal that character before finishing the pair. **Combat King 002** is awarded after the battle. Keep Lightning and Wind off Elemental Attack against this pair.

After the scenes, name Pandemona if you drew it. When control returns to **Balamb Garden's bridge**, visit the **Library Committee** for **Zell Love Scene #7**. Before setting out for Trabia, return to Balamb for one final town sweep.

{{CALLOUT:card|Balamb card and item cleanup}} If you missed the daughter's earlier match, claim the **Pandemona Card** from the **Hotel owner** now that the occupation is over. If you postponed the Queen step from the previous open-world visit, resume it here: lose **Chicobo** and send the Queen to **Dollet** before leaving Balamb. While in town, visit the port and speak to the Big Bad Rascal behind the barrels on the right. After the scene, return to Zell's house and examine his bed for **Spd Up**. Then return to Garden; the **Chubby Chocobo Card** is available from the man sitting on the bench beside the Library. The Queen's son in Dollet can return Chicobo later; continue the Queen route tracker for that recovery.

{{CALLOUT:gf|Pandemona setup}} Set Pandemona to learn **Spd-J**, then **Elem-Defx2**, the Spd+X% abilities, **Boost**, and the remaining abilities. Its main strategic value is Speed junctioning, though its summon also works against Wind-weak enemies. If the earlier GF sidequests are complete, a practical grouping is: Strength — Quezacotl, Ifrit, Pandemona; Defense — Brothers, Carbuncle, Leviathan, Tonberry; Magic — Shiva, Siren, Diablos.

{{CALLOUT:point|Shumi Village Ultima draw before Trabia}} Before moving to Trabia, return to **Shumi Village** and draw Ultima again if the point has recharged. This paid point refills after enough steps; the next story destination can make this repeat draw easy to overlook.

{{CALLOUT:training|Cactuar AP side trip}} If you skipped the earlier Cactuar AP stop, this is another convenient chance before Trabia. Land Garden on the nearby desert shore beside the small offshore **Cactuar Island**, pass through the mountain gap, then use the same southeastern **Kashkabald Desert** encounter patch. Keep **Enc-None off** so random battles can start. Squall and Selphie with **Strange Vision** have reliable weapon accuracy; other characters benefit from **Triple on Hit-J**. If you recruited Tonberry, keep it junctioned until it learns the shop abilities you want.

{{CALLOUT:hint|Stat-J Scrolls}} With **Familiar** and access to the **Timber Pet Shop**, either in person or through **Call Shop**, you can buy basic **Stat-J Scrolls** for HP, Str, Vit, Mag, and Spr. They cost **10,000 Gil each** before Haggle and can save AP. Teach a scroll only if that GF naturally supports the ability; otherwise unlearn a low-risk common command such as Magic, GF, Draw, or Item first, since those can be relearned easily.

chapters.title: Trabia Garden
chapters.content:
Your next objective is **Trabia Garden**, in the **northeastern part of Trabia Continent**. Use the large world map if the snowy northern continent is hard to read.

{{CALLOUT:story|Trabia Garden ruins}} After the entry scene, **climb up the net-like thing** to get inside the ruined Garden. Talk to the girl near Selphie and choose **Play along**. At the fountain, draw from the **Thundaga Draw Point** first; this also advances **Magic Miner**, which counts draws from field Draw Points. Then hold the walk action, **walk south 5 steps**, and examine the ground for **Weapons Mon Aug**.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Trabia Garden collectibles}} From the fountain, take the northern-right exit to the **graveyard**. Search the back of the screen near the Draw Point, especially the left side by the tombstones, for the camouflaged **Timber Maniacs** issue. It is one of the 12 magazines required for the Steam **Timber Maniacs** achievement. Return to the fountain afterward.

From the fountain, head left. Speak with the students if you want the extra flavor, but make sure to **examine the terminal** before leaving the area. Continue west, speak to the **little girl and boy**, then go two screens west to the **basketball court**. Try to leave the basketball court to start the memory sequence.

{{CALLOUT:story|Orphanage memory}} When Squall appears in **phantom form**, go through the **northern door** and talk to the boy. Follow the **stone steps down to the beach**. When control returns, talk to all the kids, leave the room for the next scene, then on the beach speak to **Irvine, Quistis, and Selphie** in order. The others have optional comments. Finally, **approach Rinoa** and form a party when prompted.

The party returns to Balamb Garden.

{{CALLOUT:relationship|Zell Love Scene #8}} Put **Zell in the active party**, visit Balamb Garden's **Library**, and speak with the Library Committee to see Scene #8 before continuing.

After the memory sequence and Zell's Library scene, return through the net entrance and challenge **Selphie's friend**, the girl she spoke with earlier, for the **Selphie Card**. Do this before leaving Trabia for the next story stop to avoid a separate return trip. Card Mod refines it into **3 Elem Guard**; each teaches a GF **Elem-Def-Jx4**.

{{CALLOUT:point|Before the next battle}} All previously available optional activities remain available here. If the paid Ultima Draw Point has recharged, make another paid draw at **Shumi Village**. When ready to continue the story, head to the **stone house on Centra continent's western edge**. You cannot enter it yet; approach **Galbadia Garden**, parked nearby, to trigger the next major sequence.

checkpoints.label: Selphie Card
checkpoints.description: After the orphanage memory scenes, return to Trabia Garden and win it from Selphie's friend.

chapters.title: Battle of the Gardens
chapters.content:
{{CALLOUT:story|Battle preparations}} Give the Garden orders: **Prepare for the attack**, **Prepare our defenses**, and **Take care of the junior classmen**. Other orders only create extra dialogue. Go down and talk to Quistis, choose a party, and remember that **Zell and Rinoa are unavailable** for this segment. Head to the 2F Hallway; leave junctions alone for now because this party is not fighting yet.

In the 2F Hallway, speak to everyone, then continue to the classroom entrance area. Talk to the pair standing there and the Junior Classman walking toward the classroom. If he enters the classroom, go in and back out to reset him. He gives you a **Cottage**. Afterward, go to the Quad, using the Save Point on the way if needed, then talk to Zell and Rinoa for the next scenes.

{{ENCOUNTERS:0}}

{{CALLOUT:point|Defending the Garden}} Control shifts to Zell's team. Set their junctions, run to the end of the Quad, leave the screen after the first scene for the next one, then run to the front gate. When Squall selects two party members, move junctions to this crew. As Squall's team, go to the classroom and defeat the four **Paratroopers**. They are tougher than standard G-Soldiers and use status attacks; GF summons work well if Silence is not blocking the command. Speak to the SeeD after the fight, then return to the bridge.

{{CALLOUT:mechanics|Emergency exit duel}} As Squall, go to the 2F hallway and talk to the Junior Classman. During the scene choose **Look around for another option**, then **emergency exit**. In the rope mini-game, block until the Paratrooper winds up for a punch, quickly kick to stun, then punch or use **Deathblow** if it has appeared. Losing only restarts the mini-game and can increase Squall's starting HP; it is not a Game Over.

When Squall lands, run left for the scene, name the ring if prompted, and answer **Rinoa, let's go**. Equip **Move-Find** to reveal the hidden **Aura Draw Point** among the trees, then draw Aura for Magic Miner progress. A high-Magic character improves the draw yield. Enter Galbadia Garden afterward.

{{ENCOUNTERS:1}}

{{CALLOUT:route|Card Key route}} Choose a party inside Galbadia Garden, then equip **Move-Find**. Reveal and draw from the hidden **Haste Draw Point** in the center of the Entrance Hall for Magic Miner progress. Go right, right again, and up the stairs. Talk to Raijin and Fujin, take the left-leading hallway, then enter the right-hand door for **Card Key 1**. Return to the entrance Save Point, take the left fork, and unlock the left-hand door. Cross the **hockey rink** and check the goal mouth with Move-Find for the hidden **Protect Draw Point**. Continue into the left-hand locker-room dead end and reveal the **Life Draw Point** there. Then use the locker room's right door, cross the next hallway, collect **Card Key 2**, and go south twice to return to the start.

From the entrance route, go right, right again, climb the stairs to the top, and go through the upper door. Follow the path until the party jumps down. On the lower level, reveal and draw from the hidden **Shell Draw Point** with Move-Find before heading to the main hall. Unlock the nearby shortcut back toward the entrance if you want save access, then continue the other way to the **main hall**.

{{CALLOUT:boss|Cerberus preparation}} Cerberus is optional but strongly worth defeating now; if missed, it can be drawn from Gargantua in Ultimecia's Castle on Disc 4. Give everyone **Draw**, put Wind, Earth, and Lightning on Elemental Defense where possible, and keep Wind and Lightning off Elemental Attack. **Float** can protect the party from Quake. Add protection against Silence and Darkness, equip **Mug**, and make sure someone can cast **Dispel**. Talk to Cerberus to begin.

**Boss: Cerberus**

Strategy: Cerberus casts Triple on itself; remove it with **Dispel**. **Float** protects against Quake, and elemental defense helps against its Wind and Lightning attacks. If Triple is available at its current level, draw it for valuable junction stock. Use **Mug** before winning if you want its ability item. Victory recruits Cerberus and unlocks its achievement. Afterward, name it and prioritize **Spd-J**, **Spr-J**, the ST-Def-J line, **Mag-J**, **ST-Atk-J**, the Spd+X% abilities, **Auto-Haste**, then cleanup.

{{CALLOUT:training|Tri-Face farming}} Tri-Faces appear often in the center of the main hall where Cerberus stood, making this a convenient farming spot before Disc 3. **Curse Spikes** can support Quistis's LV? Death route and, with **Siren at Lv 100**, the Dark Matter route for **Shockwave Pulsar**.

Save at the Save Point, leave the main hall through the left hallway, and enter the classroom on the left for **Card Key 3**. You may unlock the bottom-screen door as a shortcut, then return to the main hall. Take the exit opposite the Save Point, climb the stairs near the Reception Room, take the left hallway at the top, and ride the elevator.

{{CALLOUT:boss|Seifer setup}} Before stepping forward, equip **Bio to Elem-Atk**, **Drain to ST-Atk**, and make sure at least one character has Mug. Approach Seifer.

**Boss: Seifer (Second Battle)**

Strategy: Fire defense helps against Seifer's magic, and Bio/Drain support work well. Mug before finishing if you want his item; draw any spells you still need. Save afterward if you want a clean point before the balcony route.

Return to the stairs near the Reception Room and take the right hallway this time to reach the balcony. Follow it to the far doorway. For the final fight, use the same Seifer setup, add **Sleep in ST-Atk**, protect against Ice, Lightning, Silence, KO, and Curse if possible, and make sure someone has Draw equipped.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Draw Alexander}} Draw **Alexander** from Edea before defeating her to unlock the GF and its achievement. If missed here, Alexander can still be drawn from Catoblepas in Ultimecia's Castle on Disc 4.

**Boss: Seifer (with Edea)**

Strategy: Edea is present but cannot be targeted until Seifer falls. Mug Seifer before he falls if you want his item. Once Edea becomes targetable, put her to **Sleep** to create safer turns. Keep Spirit high, protect against Death, Ice, and Silence, and recover promptly after Maelstrom, which can leave the party critically weakened and inflict Curse. Mug Edea before ending the battle if you want her item, then draw any other magic you still need.

After Edea falls, the possession reveal plays and **Disc 2 ends**.

checkpoints.description: Unlock Guardian Force Cerberus. Defeat it in Galbadia Garden's main hall, or draw it from Gargantua in Ultimecia's Castle on Disc 4 if missed.

checkpoints.description: Defeat Cerberus in Galbadia Garden's main hall now; Gargantua in Ultimecia's Castle is the Disc 4 fallback.

checkpoints.label: Alexander
checkpoints.description: Unlock Guardian Force Alexander. Draw from Edea during the final Disc 2 battle, or from Catoblepas in Ultimecia's Castle on Disc 4 if missed.

checkpoints.description: Draw Alexander from Edea before she is defeated; Catoblepas in Ultimecia's Castle is the Disc 4 fallback.

checkpoints.description: Optional: farm Tri-Face in the main hall after Cerberus for Pain, Flare, and Curse Spike routes.

chapters.title: The Aftermath
chapters.content:
After the Disc 2 ending scene, **head to the bridge**. The next story destination is **Edea's House**, near where the enemy Garden was fought, but this is a strong cleanup window before going there.

{{CALLOUT:gf|Alexander setup}} Set the new **Alexander** GF to learn **Med Data**, **Med LV Up**, **High Mag-RF**, **Elem-Defx4**, **Elem-Atk-J**, and **Boost** in that order, followed by remaining abilities. A practical GF grouping after the Disc 2 sidequests is: **Strength team** - Quezacotl, Ifrit, Cerberus, Alexander; **Defense team** - Brothers, Carbuncle, Leviathan, Tonberry; **Magic team** - Shiva, Siren, Diablos, Pandemona.

{{CALLOUT:refinement|Leviathan and Chubby Chocobo Card Refinements}} If you won the **Leviathan Card** from Card Magician Joker, Card Mod it into 3x **Doc's Code** and use one to teach Alexander **Med Data** immediately. If you completed the Chicobo/Queen branch and have the **Chubby Chocobo Card**, Card Mod it into **100x LuvLuv G** for broad GF compatibility boosting.

{{CALLOUT:relationship|Zell Love Scene #9}} Pay one last visit to the Library with Zell in the party. This is the final Library-side setup before completing Zell's sidequest in Balamb.

{{CALLOUT:point|Repeat the Shumi Village Ultima draw}} Return to Shumi Village for another paid Ultima draw. If your main drawer is near capacity, move some Ultima stock to another character so the drawer has space for up to 15 new spells.

{{CALLOUT:sidequest|Disc 3 cleanup unlocks}} Still in Balamb Garden, go to the Training Center and take the left path to find **Weapons Mon Jul**. This is also the final advancement point for the **Novice SeeD Candidates** quest before Trabia Canyon. With Disc 3 open, the **Dollet Bone Quest** now upgrades its three dog-search rewards to **X-Potion, Mega-Potion, and Elixir**; the Sidequests entry has the full route. Previously available optional quests remain available if unfinished.

{{ENCOUNTERS:0}}

{{CALLOUT:story|Edea's House}} Edea's House is on the **western tip of Centra Continent**. Go inside for a scene and pick up **Timber Maniacs #11/12** from the ground just inside the doorway on the right. This advances the Steam **Timber Maniacs** collection; the White SeeD Ship issue is the final one. Follow Cid for the next scene, then speak with Edea; afterward, you can challenge her for the **Edea Card**.

{{CALLOUT:card|Centra rules warning}} Edea is an excellent Triple Triad player and uses Centra rules: **Random, Plus, and Same**. Try to spread Open or abolish Random/Plus before seriously chasing the Edea Card. Cid can also hold the **Seifer Card** here if it was not won earlier, but he now plays with Centra rules instead of Balamb rules.

To continue, keep talking to Edea until she stops giving new lines, then attempt to leave for a scene.

{{CALLOUT:perfect|Perfect Game Alert #11}} Talk to Edea until Adel's name appears in yellow text; this unlocks **Esthar (1)** and **Esthar (2)** in Tutorial. Also talk to Cid until he stops giving new lines to receive **Time Compression** and **The Great Hyne**. These entries belong to this Edea's House window.

After the Edea's House scene, Squall returns to Balamb Garden's cockpit. There is nothing new to collect in Garden at this point. Head to the Infirmary, talk to **Kadowaki**, then approach Rinoa to trigger the next sequence.

checkpoints.label: Weapons Mon Jul
checkpoints.description: After Disc 3 begins, take the left path in Balamb Garden Training Center.

checkpoints.label: Zell Love Scene #9
checkpoints.description: Visit the Library with Zell in the party during the immediate Disc 3 aftermath window.

checkpoints.label: Timber Maniacs
checkpoints.description: Pick up the magazine on the floor near the doorway inside Edea's House.

checkpoints.label: Edea Card
checkpoints.description: Win from Edea at Edea's House; manipulate Centra rules first if needed.

checkpoints.label: Tutorial entries
checkpoints.description: Talk to Edea and Cid until they stop giving new lines to unlock Esthar (1), Esthar (2), Time Compression, and The Great Hyne.

chapters.title: Trabia Canyon
chapters.content:
{{CALLOUT:story|Laguna film scene}} In the dream sequence, choose who receives each junction set. **Laguna will always have Squall's** set. **Kiros** and **Ward** can receive whichever other sets you choose; if the **Shumi Village Timber Maniacs** issue was read, Ward is absent. Make sure every available character receives a junction set before continuing.

The sword-fighting mini-game is about timing, not stats. On PlayStation, **Square blocks** and **Triangle attacks**; use the equivalent controls on your platform. Block the dragon’s lunge and any unusually quick recovery, since it attacks almost immediately after that recovery. Strike during safe openings; expect about ten landed hits. If you lose, you can retry.

After a successful film take, choose **H-Hold on a sec** to regain control of Laguna's party before the real fight. Recheck junctions, return to the Save Point, and **Save and Tent** if needed. You can run around the mountainside for **Bite Bug** and **Mesmerize** encounters, but they are not especially useful here.

{{ENCOUNTERS:0}}

{{CALLOUT:point|Ruby Dragon draw setup}} This scripted **Ruby Dragon** encounter is an early chance to stock powerful magic. Tonberry’s **LV Up** and **LV Down** commands let you control its level and Draw table. Raise it to **Lv 45+** for **Meteor**, which is not available below that range; the enemy entry shows the current Draw list.

{{CALLOUT:warning|High-level Ruby Dragon danger}} Raising Ruby Dragon to **Lv 45+** unlocks powerful attacks, including **Breath** and Meteor. Breath is a huge non-elemental physical attack and can be used against a living **three-person party** with nobody KO'd. If Ward is absent, Breath is not used in this Laguna dream fight, even when the dragon is high level.

For a non-perfect file, the easy drawing method is to **KO a character** while the other two draw, then rotate revives and KOs so everyone gets time to stock magic. This prevents Breath from being available, but it is not valid for a **Perfect Game** file that tracks character KOs.

For a perfect-file route, keep everyone alive. Junction **Meltdown to Vit** and **Regen or stronger magic to HP**, and bring **Protect** plus reliable healing. If you recruited **Cerberus** at Galbadia Garden, give someone the GF command and summon it for party-wide **Double/Triple** before raising the dragon with LV Up. Cast Protect on everyone, then draw while refreshing protection and healing after Breath or Meteor. This takes longer but avoids KO records.

When drawing is complete, use LV Down to **lower the dragon’s level** before defeating it. This limits EXP and reduces pressure from its high-level attacks. If Meteor is painfully slow to draw, it is reasonable to skip heavy stocking here and draw it later with better Magic stats.

checkpoints.label: Ruby Dragon draw stock
checkpoints.description: Optional: use LV Up to raise the Trabia Canyon Ruby Dragon to Lv 45+ for Flare and Meteor, then lower its level again before defeating it.

chapters.title: Picking Up the Trail
chapters.content:
{{CALLOUT:sidequest|Novice SeeD Candidates reward}} If you triggered every **Novice SeeD Candidates** dialogue window, return to Balamb Garden's **Cafeteria** now to view the final reward scene.

As Squall, go to the cockpit and fly to Edea's House. Speak with Edea to receive the **Sorceress' Letter**. There is nothing else required here unless you want to play Edea or Cid in Triple Triad or manipulate Centra rules. Return to Balamb Garden afterward.

{{CALLOUT:point|White SeeD Ship location}} Find the **White SeeD Ship** among the Centra inlets near Edea's House. To board, drive Balamb Garden into the ship.

After boarding, watch the scene and talk to the White SeeD crew if you wish. Head toward the stairs for the next scene, then go upstairs. Inspect the floor on the left for **Timber Maniacs #12/12**, the final issue. Collect it before leaving the ship; it completes the Steam **Timber Maniacs** achievement when the other eleven are already collected.

{{CALLOUT:warning|Zone and Girl Next Door}} If you still have the one-of-a-kind **Girl Next Door**, speak to **Zone three times** to reach his offer. Give the magazine for free to receive the **Shiva Card** and **Rename Card**, sell it for about **25,000 Gil**, or keep it. Keeping it is recommended for a completion-focused file; the two rewards have other acquisition routes.

{{CALLOUT:card|Watts and Angelo Card}} Back downstairs, **Watts** still uses **Galbadia rules**. If the **Angelo Card** was not won earlier, he can still have it here. The Angelo Card is much stronger as a refinement target than as a playing card: Card Mod turns it into **100 Elixirs**.

Go downstairs into the cabin for a scene. Afterward, draw **Holy** from the Draw Point with the character who has the highest Magic stat; this also advances Steam’s **Magic Miner** achievement. Then speak to the **leader** until the next story scene plays.

checkpoints.label: Sorceress' Letter
checkpoints.description: Speak with Edea at Edea's House before searching for the White SeeD Ship.

checkpoints.label: Timber Maniacs
checkpoints.description: Collect the final issue (#12/12) from the left side of the upper room before leaving the White SeeD Ship; this completes the Steam achievement if the other eleven are collected.

checkpoints.label: Shiva Card
checkpoints.description: Optional Zone trade: give Girl Next Door for Shiva Card and Rename Card, or keep the unique magazine.

checkpoints.label: Angelo Card
checkpoints.description: If missed earlier, win from Watts on the White SeeD Ship; he uses Galbadia rules.

chapters.title: Journey to the Silent Country
chapters.content:
After the scene, Squall is back aboard Balamb Garden. If anything remains on the **White SeeD Ship**, it can still be revisited; speak to the boy on the ship's starting screen to return to Garden.

{{CALLOUT:point|Shumi Ultima draw before the prep loop}} Return to **Shumi Village** for another paid draw from the Ultima Draw Point before beginning the preparation loop.

{{ENCOUNTERS:0}}

{{CALLOUT:sidequest|Preparations for the journey}} This prep is optional but strongly recommended. Return to **Kashkabald Desert** and fight Cactuars until **Alexander learns Med LV Up**. Staying longer is fine, but Med LV Up is the key target.

{{CALLOUT:point|Shumi Ultima draw after desert training}} The desert AP farming should have recharged the Shumi Village Draw Point. Return and draw Ultima again before gathering the Doomtrain materials.

Collect at least **6 each of Steel Pipe, Remedy+, and Malboro Tentacle** — these are the materials for **Doomtrain**, which you can recruit later at Tears' Point after reaching Esthar. **Steel Pipe** can be mugged from **Wendigo** near the first Laguna dream area away from the cliffs, or refined from **Elastoid Cards**. **Remedy+** is simplest: buy **60 Remedies** from a shop and refine them with Med LV Up. **Malboro Tentacle** can come from Malboros in **Grandidi Forest** near **Chocobo Sanctuary**; bring a Chocobo from Roaming Forest and use **Degenerator** to end Malboro fights quickly. For a perfect-game route, **Malboro Cards** are often cleaner because 4 cards refine into 1 Malboro Tentacle.

{{CALLOUT:point|Last Shumi Ultima draw before Esthar}} Make one final paid Ultima draw at Shumi Village before leaving the region for Esthar.

{{CALLOUT:story|Setting out for Esthar}} Go to **FH**. After the scene, follow the linear path. When control returns, talk to Rinoa, then speak to Edea. Form a party with **Edea available as a temporary member**. For a perfect-game record, leave Edea out of the active party so she does not accumulate kills or KOs. Then run into the **dried-up lake** to the east. Seaside Station can be re-entered, but its only real use here is card play with the old man.

{{ENCOUNTERS:1}}

{{CALLOUT:route|Great Salt Lake route}} Reform the party on entry and go north. Climb to the upper ledge using the **skull and spine**. On the next screen, check to the right of the entry for a hidden **Meteor Draw Point**; reveal it with **Move-Find**. Cross the spine to the next screen and use the **Thundaga Draw Point** if desired, then continue north and use the jump prompt at the cliff. Drawing from either point advances Steam’s **Magic Miner** achievement. On the following screen, the right path leads to a **Save Point**.

{{CALLOUT:boss|Abadon preparation}} Save at the point, then go left two screens and take the path up to Abadon. Equip **Recover or Revive** if available, or use **Fire- or Holy-elemental magic** on Elemental Attack. Equip **Mug**, protect against **Silence and Confuse**, and equip **Draw** if you plan to stock Flare.

{{CALLOUT:boss|Abadon strategy}} Abadon is undead. **Revive** can finish it outright; **Recover**, X-Potions, and Elixirs deal heavy damage, though high-level HP may take a second use. Mug for **Power Wrist** only if you prefer the steal: a successful Mug prevents the guaranteed **10x Flare Stone** drop, so skip Mug if you want those stones. If fighting conventionally, Abadon alternates between sitting and standing every few rounds; standing greatly raises Vit and Spr. At **Lv 30+**, draw Flare before ending the battle.

After the battle, continue to the right along the cliff until the background flickers. Examine the ladder-like spot at the edge to open the hidden route, then follow it into the **mystery building**.

{{CALLOUT:point|Mystery building}} There is very little to collect inside. On the second screen, examine the **console** for story context, then follow the linear path through the scenes.

checkpoints.label: Doomtrain ingredient prep
checkpoints.description: Collect 6 Steel Pipe, 6 Remedy+, and 6 Malboro Tentacle before heading for Esthar if you want Doomtrain ready later.

checkpoints.label: Meteor Draw Point
checkpoints.description: Hidden to the right of the entry point on the upper ledge after climbing the skull/spine; reveal with Move-Find.

checkpoints.label: Thundaga Draw Point
checkpoints.description: On the spine route before the cliff jump prompt.

chapters.title: The Resistance
chapters.content:
The Esthar flashback prompts you to assign junction sets to **Laguna's gang**. **Squall is always Laguna**, while **Kiros and Ward** can receive whichever remaining sets you prefer.

Start by talking to the **Esthar Soldier near the elevator**, then the soldier near the other door. Address the **Moomba twice**, speak to the man, then speak to the Moomba again.

{{ENCOUNTERS:0}}

A lone **Esthar Soldier** attacks after the dialogue; defeat him. **Kiros and Ward** then join Laguna. Choose **Better check** to inspect the junctions: their GFs have been removed, so re-equip GFs and rebuild their junctions before choosing **Perfect...!** to start the next fight.

Defeat **Gesper**, an Esthar Soldier, and a **Cyborg Esthar Soldier**, then ride the elevator up. Before approaching Odine upstairs, equip **Mug** if you want the Laser Cannon from the Elastoid encounter.

{{CALLOUT:item|Weapons Mon 1st}} Keep approaching Dr. Odine until the group runs outside. After the scene, use the Save Point and draw **Death** from the nearby Draw Point if you want the spell or progress toward **Magic Miner**. Re-enter the lab and pick up **Weapons Mon 1st** from the floor before taking the elevator down. If you miss this optional pickup, Esthar Book Store sells it once **Familiar** is available.

{{CALLOUT:warning|Elastoid draw and Mug window}} In the final Laguna **Elastoid** encounter, a level **30+** variant can yield **Meltdown** through Draw and **Laser Cannon** through Mug. Stock Meltdown rather than casting it to advance **Magician**. Mug Laser Cannon to teach Quistis **Homing Laser**, her second-strongest single-target Limit Break. If Meltdown is missing from the level 30+ Draw list or Mug fails, reload from the outside Save Point and retry. Laser Cannon has another opportunity later in the game.

Follow Odine through the elevator and outside for the next scenes. Afterward, defeat two Esthar Soldiers and try the locked door. Draw **Double** from the Draw Point just to the right of the door, then examine the central bench/platform and choose **Sit down** to ride it to the upper level. In the next room, defeat two Cyborg Esthar Soldiers. Examine the **right side of the console** to unlock the door, ride back down, return to the entrance, and go through that door for the scene.

checkpoints.label: Weapons Mon 1st
checkpoints.description: After Odine's group runs outside, use the Save Point and re-enter the lab for the magazine; if skipped, buy it at Esthar Book Store once Familiar is available.

checkpoints.label: Early Laser Cannon
checkpoints.description: At Lv 30+, draw and stock Meltdown from Elastoid before Mugging Laser Cannon; if missed, Mobile Type 8 in Lunatic Pandora provides a later source.

chapters.title: Esthar
chapters.content:
Back as Squall, watch the Esthar arrival scenes. Before challenging **Odine** for the **Ward Card**, save at the city's Save/Heal point if you may reset rule spread; the Palace has no Save Point. Odine remains available until the plot advances. If you miss the card, the completed CC Group is the Disc 4 fallback.

{{CALLOUT:map|Esthar City Map}} Esthar is one of the largest areas in the game. On the city map, **yellow numbered points** are for a later quest, though yellow-circle screens can still be visited now. **White marks** show key locations and **green circles** show other screens. At Yellow Spot #2, paths cross visually but do not intersect; keep moving along the same path you entered from. The Combat King 004 man screen intersects the Odine's Lab path and Yellow Spot #2 path, while the outer spur does not connect to either.

{{CALLOUT:point|City points of interest}} You begin at the Presidential Palace; the President's office is inaccessible. Leave the Palace and go left twice, then bottom-left to reach the area outside the **Airstation** and speak to the **Presidential Aide**. Return to the Palace waiting room after the conversation. From the Palace, go left twice and right twice to the mapped **Combat King 004** screen; speak to the soldier until his dialogue repeats. This sets up his free magazine handoff during the next Esthar visit as Zell. If you miss that handoff, the Esthar Book Store can sell Combat King 004 once **Familiar** is available. From the soldier, go right twice, down-right, then right to reach the **Shopping Mall**. **Odine's Lab** cannot be entered yet. The **Save/Heal** point is a Save Point under a device that restores the whole party.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Occult Fan IV}} After speaking to the Aide, speak to the **Presidential Secretary** in the Palace waiting room, near the room where Rinoa was left with Odine. The Secretary leaves **Occult Fan IV** on the floor. Pick it up before advancing to **Lunar Gate**; this pickup window closes when the story moves on.

{{CALLOUT:shop|Shopping Mall gifts}} The Mall has **Rinrin's Store** (Pet Shop), **Cloud's Shop**, **Johnny's Shop** (Esthar Shop!!!), **Don Juan's Shop** (Junk Shop), **Karen's Store** (Book Store), and **Cheryl's Store**. Each shop's gift can be received only once, and shop availability is random. Gifts: Rinrin - none; Cloud - Hi-Potion or X-Potion; Johnny - Hi-Potion or Mega-Potion; Don Juan - none; Karen - Hi-Potion or Mega Phoenix; Cheryl - **Rosetta Stone**. Cheryl's store never opens, but repeated attempts can produce the Rosetta Stone as a gift. It is very rare and does not give a clear notification, so check the inventory periodically; you can keep trying on the next Esthar visit if needed.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Esthar Call Shop registrations}} To register the four regular stores for **Call Shop**, keep trying until each one opens normally: Rinrin's, Cloud's, Johnny's, and Karen's. A closed response or a free gift does not count as a visit for registration. Don Juan's Junk Shop is excluded, and Cheryl's never-open store cannot be registered. Johnny's **Esthar Shop!!!** may take repeated attempts, but once it opens in person it remains available in Call Shop. If you leave now, you return to Esthar as Zell in the next chapter and can finish any outstanding registrations before talking to Odine to start the mission timer; make sure all four are registered before time compression, since some Disc 4 items otherwise become unavailable.

{{CALLOUT:refinement|Infinite Money Trick}} If Leviathan has **Recov Med-RF** and Tonberry has **Haggle** and **Sell-High**, use Esthar Shop!!! to buy **100 Tents and 100 Cottages**. With Haggle they cost 210,000 Gil; without it they cost 280,000. Refine them into **75 Mega-Potions** and sell them: Sell-High returns 562,500 Gil, while the normal sale is 375,000. With both abilities the net is about **352,500 Gil** per loop; with neither, it is 95,000 Gil. With only one ability, the net depends on which one is active. New high-value routes include Power Wrist/Hypno Crown -> Aura Stone -> Aura, Edea Card -> Royal Crown, Ward Card -> Gaea's Ring, Giant's Ring -> Protect, Force Armlet -> Shell, and 10 Elixirs -> Megalixir. Card Mod consumes the **Edea** and **Ward** cards; keep them if you are completing the rare-card collection, or recover replacements from the CC Group before refining them.

Esthar shops also sell useful items. Rinrin's Pet Shop sells **Pet Pals Vol. 5** and **Vol. 6** for 1,000 Gil each; Vol. 5 teaches Angelo Search and Vol. 6 teaches Rinoa's **Wishing Star**. The Book Store can cover missed Combat King and Weapons Monthly issues, with high-end tomes requiring Familiar. Esthar Shop!!! has the strongest healing-item selection available now.

{{ENCOUNTERS:0}}

{{CALLOUT:point|Great Plains of Esthar}} World-map encounters vary by area. Around the city, expect **Bite Bug, Gayla, Glacial Eye**. Near the **northern cliffs**, expect Bite Bug, Caterchipillar, Gayla, Glacial Eye, and Hexadragon. On the broad plains, **Mesmerize** and a rare **Malboro** can appear. Use a car or Enc-None if you are not farming; protect against Malboro's Bad Breath if hunting for **Malboro Tentacles**.

{{CALLOUT:sidequest|Acquiring Doomtrain}} Doomtrain can be recruited before Lunar Gate. The previous chapter set the target at **6 Remedy+**, **6 Steel Pipe**, and **6 Malboro Tentacle**; return to that preparation route for the acquisition options if any are still missing. If you do not have the **Solomon Ring**, travel to **Tears' Point** on Esthar's southeast side and follow the roads around the northern coast. Draw **Life** from the point before the statue and **Reflect** from the point beside it for **Magic Miner**, then take the ring from the statue's feet.

When the ingredients are ready, use the Solomon Ring from the item menu; it consumes the materials, recruits Doomtrain, and unlocks its achievement. Teach Doomtrain **Forbid Med-RF first**; its other learnable abilities include **ST-Def-Jx4**, **Elem-Defx4**, **Auto-Shell**, and **Boost**.

After exploring, go to **Lunar Gate**, the next story destination. Enter, watch the scene, and follow the woman. Say you are ready, then choose any reply and form a party. **Rinoa occupies a slot**, so choose one third member; that character does not fight in the upcoming space sequence. Confirm with **Yeah...** and enter the pod. As Zell, run outside and choose one party member to accompany Zell and **Edea**. Junction as needed and return to Esthar. For a perfect-game record, keep Edea from getting kills or KOs.

checkpoints.label: Ward Card
checkpoints.description: Win Ward from Odine during the Esthar visit; if skipped, the CC Group can recover rare cards later.

checkpoints.label: Occult Fan IV
checkpoints.description: Speak to the Presidential Aide outside the Airstation, return to the Palace waiting room, then pick up the magazine the Secretary leaves on the floor.

checkpoints.label: Combat King 004 handoff
checkpoints.description: Speak to the soldier at the mapped Combat King 004 screen to unlock his free magazine handoff during the next Esthar visit as Zell.

checkpoints.label: Rosetta Stone gift
checkpoints.description: Repeat Cheryl's Store attempts for the rare gift; it may appear without notification, so check inventory periodically and retry on a later Esthar visit if needed.

checkpoints.label: Esthar Call Shop registrations
checkpoints.description: Open Rinrin's, Cloud's, Johnny's, and Karen's shops in person before time compression; closed results and free gifts do not register.

checkpoints.label: Doomtrain
checkpoints.description: Use Solomon Ring with 6 Remedy+, 6 Steel Pipe, and 6 Malboro Tentacle.

enemies.name: Malboro
enemies.notes: Rare plains encounter; fight only if you still need the Doomtrain ingredient.

chapters.title: Siege of Esthar
chapters.content:
At Esthar, make sure the active party is junctioned before starting the operation. From the city entrance, go left until you reach the **Save Point** and save. If any **Call Shop** stores remain unregistered, finish those checks at the Shopping Mall using the previous Esthar route; this is the last city window before time compression. Then return to **Odine's Lab**, ride the platform, enter the lab, and ask any background questions before the timer starts.

{{CALLOUT:map|Timed Contact Points}} The mission timer starts when you leave **Odine's Lab**. The three yellow spots are contact windows: **Spot #1** is **15:00-12:00**, **Spot #2** is **10:00-5:00**, and **Spot #3** is **3:00-0:00**. Random battles begin around the city, so **Enc-None** makes the timed run safer. Aim for Spot #1; the first contact is visible at 15:00, and you have five minutes from the 20:00 start to reach it.

{{CALLOUT:missable|Combat King 004}} On the timed route from the Lab, go bottom-right, left twice, up, then right twice to reach the mapped Combat King screen. If you spoke to this soldier before Lunar Gate, talk to him now for **Combat King 004**, then go right once to Spot #1. The prerequisite conversation is what enables this free handoff; if you skipped it, the Esthar Book Store is a later fallback when **Familiar** is available.

Reach **Yellow Spot #1** if at all possible. If you arrive before 15:00, wait at the contact point. Missing it does not end the mission: Spots #2 and #3 are still boarding chances, but you are evicted before collecting most Lunatic Pandora treasures. If the timer reaches zero before you board, the immediate visit ends; when the Disc 1 setup flags are in place, return for these Lunatic Pandora treasures during the later Ragnarok assault.

{{ENCOUNTERS:0}}

{{CALLOUT:story|Lunatic Pandora Arrival}} When the Lunatic Pandora appears, approach it and defeat the **G-Soldier** and **Elite Soldier** before that spot's cutoff: 12:00 at Spot #1, 5:00 at Spot #2, or 0:00 at Spot #3. If the battle is still active when the timer passes the cutoff, you miss that contact and must catch the next one. Boarding at Spot #1 gives access to the full treasure route.

{{ENCOUNTERS:1}}

{{CALLOUT:point|Lunatic Pandora enemy levels}} Inside Lunatic Pandora, non-Galbadia war-asset encounters are fixed at **Level 1**. Removing Enc-None is worthwhile if you want AP, drops, or Mugs with almost no EXP pressure. Galbadian war assets use their normal level behavior; check their encounter entries for level-specific Draw/Mug/Drop results.

After boarding at the first contact point, draw **Meteor** from the **Meteor Draw Point** immediately to the right. Go upstairs into the three-elevator chamber and draw **Curaga** from its **Curaga Draw Point** before exploring. **Elevator #1** leads toward the exit, **Elevator #2** is a dead end, and **Elevator #3** leads to the treasure route; take #3 first.

At the bottom, go right, descend the stairs, then climb down the ladder and draw **Confuse** from the **Confuse Draw Point**. If Laguna found the **first-intersection Old Key** in the earlier Centra excavation sequence, the nearby right-hand door is open; enter for **LuvLuv G**. If Laguna pushed the tunnel boulder into the wall, cross it to continue left.

{{CALLOUT:treasure|Disc 1 prerequisite treasures}} The panel rewards depend on Laguna's excavation actions in Disc 1. The **middle hatch lever** reveals the **Silence Draw Point**; the **left hatch lever plus the red switch** opens the **Phoenix Pinion** route; and the **right hatch lever plus the blue switch** reveals the **Power Generator**, which teaches Quistis **Ray-Bomb**. The **Old Key near the Confuse Draw Point and barrels** opens the later door to the one-time Ultima point. Setting both detonator switches clears the boulder route to Combat King 005, and pushing the tunnel-wall rock reveals the later Spd-J Scroll. If you skipped an action, its reward cannot be collected on this visit.

On the next screen, collect **Combat King 005** from the ground by the right wall if Laguna completed the red-and-blue detonator sequence. If that setup was missed, buy the magazine later from the Esthar Book Store when **Familiar** is available. The far door opens only if Laguna picked up the **other Old Key**, near the Confuse point and barrels; behind it is a one-time **Ultima Draw Point**. It does not replenish, so either draw now or leave it until your strongest Magic stat is in place. Return to the elevator room when finished.

Climb back up and take **Elevator #1**. In the cave outside, use the **Holy Draw Point** before continuing. Near the elevator screen's exit, inspect the left-wall cavity opened by Laguna's tunnel-wall rock for the **Spd-J Scroll**. Continue upward until the scene ends the exploration. The Meteor, Curaga, Confuse, Silence, Ultima, and Holy Draw Points all contribute to the cumulative Steam **Magic Miner** achievement.

checkpoints.label: Combat King 004
checkpoints.description: Optional free handoff during the timed city route if you spoke to the soldier before Lunar Gate; otherwise buy Combat King 004 later at the Esthar Book Store when Familiar is available.
